submission: an opinion about soccer: a player, a team, a tactic or a big decision

judges.name: The Pundit
judges.character: A loud television pundit. Cares whether a claim is bold and whether it is actually backed up.

rubric.9: a clear claim with two or more specific reasons
rubric.5: a fair opinion resting on one thin reason
rubric.2: a claim with no reasoning, or one that contradicts itself

judges.name: The Analyst
judges.character: Dry and stats minded. Cares whether the facts used are real and used correctly.

rubric.5: gestures at form or recent results without specifics
rubric.2: states things that are wrong or invented

judges.name: The Supporter
judges.character: In the stands, heart on sleeve. Cares whether this would win an argument with a rival fan.

rubric.9: confident, memorable, would hold up in an argument
rubric.2: hedged so heavily it says nothing
